fato_historico: 1521: Christian II of Denmark is deposed as king of Sweden and Gustav Vasa is elected regent.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to step into your regal grace today. Just as tides of change shift power dynamics in history, you may find it is a good time to reconsider how you lead your own life. Lean into your courage, embrace your inner throne, and let your natural charisma shine as you navigate new beginnings with warmth.
frase_do_dia: The brightest crown you wear is your own authentic and courageous spirit.
significado_numero: A powerful cycle signifying personal freedom and major transformative leadership shifts.
conselho: Trust your intuition and reclaim your path with confidence and gentle strength today.
